summary: To provision ephemeral MCP servers in jobs, keep credentials in the AAP credential store and build an EE (ee-minimal-rhel9 base, microdnf) whose append_final runs ansible.mcp_builder.install_mcp with mcp_servers=github_mcp.
questions: How do I build an execution environment with an MCP server?

answer_card.title: EE with the GitHub MCP server
answer_card.answer_md:
```
version: 3
images:
  base_image:
    name: ansible-automation-platform-26/ee-minimal-rhel9:latest
dependencies:
  galaxy: requirements.yml
options:
  package_manager_path: /usr/bin/microdnf
additional_build_steps:
  append_final: |
    RUN ansible-playbook ansible.mcp_builder.install_mcp -e mcp_servers=github_mcp -e github_mcp_mode=remote
```
